maddeler.e:
تناثرت (form VI)
# تَنَاثَرْتُ (tanāṯartu) /ta.naː.θar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
# تَنَاثَرْتَ (tanāṯarta) /ta.naː.θar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
# تَنَاثَرْتِ (tanāṯarti) /ta.naː.θar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
# تَنَاثَرَتْ (tanāṯarat) /ta.naː.θa.rat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
